data.body:
[P2] Avoid cancelling ongoing retirement a second time

Cancelling the run propagates cancellation through the first `gather` to every case. Once one case finishes and re-raises `CancelledError`, that gather returns immediately, and this loop cancels slower cases again while they are performing bounded cleanup. This can abort `adapter.retire` before its budget expires, leaving executions or controls behind after a single cancellation request. Avoid recancelling tasks already handling cancellation, or protect their bounded cleanup from this second cancellation. Add a multi-case regression where one retirement completes quickly and another needs additional time.
